You will leverage automation, data-driven methodologies, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve verification productivity, accelerate debug, enhance coverage analysis, and help deliver high-quality silicon. This role provides the opportunity to work at the intersection of networking silicon, advanced verification methodologies, and AI-driven engineering productivity. You will help shape how modern verification teams leverage automation and intelligent workflows to improve quality, scalability, and time-to-market. THE PERSON: You have a passion for modern, complex processor architectures, digital design, and verification. You are a collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and experience working with engineers across multiple sites and time zones. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, are eager to learn, and are motivated to tackle challenging technical problems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, and firmware engineers to understand new features and define verification requirements; Build comprehensive verification plans that account for interactions across hardware, firmware, software, and system-level use cases; Develop directed and constrained-random tests, verification environments, and automation infrastructure; Estimate verification effort and identify required enhancements to verification environments and methodologies; Debug test failures to determine root cause and work with RTL and firmware engineers to resolve design defects; Review and drive functional and code coverage closure through targeted test development and analysis; Contribute to advanced verification methodologies spanning simulation, emulation, and data-driven analytics to accelerate silicon quality and release readiness; Develop automation solutions and leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve verification efficiency, debug productivity, coverage analysis, and test development; Drive continuous improvement of verification processes through scripting, automation, and emerging AI technologies. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Proficient in IP-level ASIC verification; Strong experience with UVM testbenches and SystemVerilog; Proficient in debugging RTL and firmware using industry-standard simulation tools; Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, C, and C++; Experience developing UVM-based verification frameworks, reusable components, and verification methodologies; Experience with Python, Perl, Shell, Makefiles, or similar scripting languages; Familiarity with data analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices; Experience applying AI/ML-assisted tools to verification, debug, coverage closure, or engineering productivity workflows; Experience using Python-based frameworks and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering efficiency; Good understanding of SystemC and TLM; related experience is a plus; Exposure to networking, packet processing, Ethernet, SmartNIC, or networking processor architectures is highly desirable; Exposure to leadership and mentorship is an asset. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Apply Now Don't forget to mention EuroTechJobs when applying.
